features: Fast Property Calculation: MW, LogP, TPSA, charge, drug-likeness (~2 seconds for 8 peptides)
Statistical Sequence Generation: Diverse cyclic peptides with constraints (~0.1 seconds for 10 sequences)
Comprehensive Analysis: Amino acid composition, physicochemical properties, visualization
Batch Processing: Async job submission for large-scale analysis
No GPU Required: CPU-only operation with minimal dependencies

claude_code_examples: @examples/data/sequences/demo_cyclic_peptides.fasta: Reference the main demo FASTA file

common_issues: Environment not found: Recreate with mamba create -p ./env python=3.10
Import errors: Verify with python -c "import numpy, pandas, matplotlib"
matplotlib backend issues: Set MPLBACKEND=Agg for headless systems
MCP server not found: Check with claude mcp list and re-add if needed
Invalid sequence error: Ensure sequences contain only standard amino acids
Job stuck in pending: Check jobs/ directory and view logs
Slow analysis: Use --no-viz for faster execution
